column34: A textual value used to establish a link between the payment and the Invoice, issued by the Seller.
column35: Used for creditor's critical reconciliation information. This information element helps the Seller to assign an incoming payment to the relevant payment process. In a payment transaction this reference is transferred back to the Seller as Remittance Information.
